post.title: Refinancing federal student loans: what you give up
post.ig:
This loan move could save $3,600. But there's no going back.
Example: $40,000 over 10 years is about $455/mo at 6.52% (the 2026-27 federal undergrad rate) vs $424/mo at an example 5% private rate, about $3,640 less interest.
Refinancing into a private loan ends income-driven plans, PSLF, federal deferment/forbearance and the federal disability discharge.
As of early 2026, PSLF borrowers had about $75,000 forgiven on average ($90.6B, 1.2M+ borrowers).
Sources: Federal Student Aid; CFPB; FSA PSLF data.
